Now that the site is fully hosted on Cloudflare Pages, we want to allow users to interact with code examples directly, without provisioning heavy backend containers.

Using the `shinylive` Quarto extension, we can compile a Python environment down to WebAssembly (Pyodide), letting readers execute Python right here on this page.

## Interactive Python Example

Below is a Shinylive interactive cell. When the page loads, it downloads a lightweight WASM Python runtime. You can edit the code and hit 'Play' to run it directly in your browser!

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true

from shiny import App, render, ui

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.input_slider("n", "N", 0, 100, 20),
    ui.output_text_verbatim("txt"),
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.text
    def txt():
        return f"n*2 is {input.n() * 2}"

app = App(app_ui, server)
```

With capabilities like this, our blog posts are transformed from static text into living computational essays.
